integrity: All mathematical claims are analytical within the explicitly stated harmonic model. Finite checks are regression tests, not proof. Previously established integral, covariance, threshold and zero-mode lines are credited, not presented as new.
scientific_limitations: Thermodynamic limit must precede critical pressure limit.
Perturbative harmonic theory cannot predict nonlinear post-buckling dynamics or melting.
No uniform finite-size crossover or forcing with spatial correlations is claimed.
The originating article already gives exact Fourier integrals; independent assessment of the asymptotic contribution as mathematically original remains outstanding.
scientific_scope: Stationary nearest-neighbor harmonic triangular crystal in infinite volume, isotropic local white and exponentially correlated force covariances, stable prestress B/A=-1/3+delta with delta approaching zero from above; bond displacement variance and its critical Fourier measure.
title: Sharp inverse-square-root buckling susceptibility in a triangular active crystal
